description: Each step of the five primary journeys (DR-0003 decision P10) mapped to one leaf (the one that completes the step; with lists the others it needs), the milestone where the step first works (spec 3104-3147), and the readiness gate it waits on. A journey's milestone is its latest step's. #173 (ROUNDS-34-L04) keeps each journey pending until its completing leaf and every other step leaf are done, then activates it; #176 runs them as release gates.

steps.text: The user opens Career Profile with no canonical facts.
steps.note: The Career Profile empty state; first-run step FR.2.

steps.text: The product offers manual setup, resume/file import, JSON Resume, LinkedIn export, GitHub, or paste.
steps.note: One chooser: #49's openCapture lists the sources #65 registers; #66 to #70 add them.

steps.text: The source is preserved before extraction.
steps.note: Raw sources are stored only after ROUNDS-14's privacy decisions (spec 3094).

steps.text: Extraction creates staged claims and duplicate candidates.
The user reviews grouped entity changes.
Accepted changes commit as one Profile Revision.
The profile opens with completeness explanations and unresolved captures.
steps.note: Completeness explanations are assigned here (DR-0003 decision P10); #65 leaves them to this leaf.

journeys.title: Add an opportunity from a job posting

steps.text: The user invokes Capture from Today, Pipeline, or Command Center.
steps.note: From Pipeline in Milestone 2; Command Center through #127; Today through #145 in Milestone 6.

steps.text: They paste a URL, description, or natural-language note.
Rounds proposes Organization, Opportunity, requirements, source metadata, and optional Pursuit creation.
steps.note: Every path works with AI off.

steps.text: Existing organization/opportunity candidates are shown.
The user reviews and commits.
The Opportunity Workspace opens with suggested next steps.
steps.note: Stages 1 to 3 of #104 land in Milestone 2.

steps.text: The user schedules or imports an interview event.
The event inherits its pursuit and opportunity context.
steps.note: A round activity takes a slot in its own Pursuit's process.

steps.text: Rounds derives a preparation plan from JD requirements, interview type, remaining time, previous attempts, profile stories, and readiness gaps.
The user accepts, edits, or dismisses recommended Actions.
Practice attempts and completed Actions update readiness.
Today reprioritizes without duplicating task records.
The user creates an Artifact Edition from an Opportunity Workspace.
Rounds proposes relevant canonical facts.
steps.note: #85's relevance slot stays off, and selection manual, until #139's evidence lookup ships.

steps.text: The user selects, orders, hides, and rewrites facts for this edition.
Overrides remain visibly distinct from canonical facts.
The user may propose an override back to the profile as a reviewed change.
steps.note: Stage 4 of #82 sends #77's ProposeOverrideToProfile; #61 reviews and #64 commits.

steps.text: A submitted version freezes its source profile and opportunity revisions.
Later canonical changes show as optional edition updates, never silent rewrites.
steps.note: Update available: use the update or keep this version.

steps.text: The completed interview event opens a concise debrief.
The user records questions, signals, confidence, feedback, contacts, and follow-ups manually or in natural language.
steps.note: Manual in stage 2; natural language in stage 3 through #181's note capture.

steps.text: AI may propose structured events, Actions, practice gaps, stories, or profile evidence.
steps.note: Only after the round is completed, so nothing assists a live interview (spec 178).

steps.text: The user reviews canonical mutations.
Readiness and Today update from accepted evidence.

firstRun.rule: No second chooser: the Today and Career Profile empty states open #49's openCapture, which lists the sources #65 registers; neither lists sources itself.

steps.surface: Today empty state: one panel, "Start with your career history", into the Career Profile empty state, with Capture second
Career Profile empty state: manual setup, or import through Capture
The bootstrap sources: manual setup, resume file, JSON Resume, LinkedIn export, GitHub, and paste
